name: GitLab MCP Server
summary: GitLab's built-in MCP server for working with projects, issues, merge requests, work items and pipelines from MCP clients; GA in GitLab 19.5.
description: Available on Free, Premium and Ultimate tiers on GitLab.com, Self-Managed and Dedicated; access must be allowed for the top-level group (GitLab.com) or instance. Supports OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration; actions run under the user's existing GitLab permissions. On GitLab.com the per-user limit is 60 calls/minute on Free and 600 on Premium and Ultimate.

agent_access.notes: Self-managed instances use https://<your-gitlab>/api/v4/mcp. Accepts an OAuth token with the `mcp` scope (via dynamic client registration) or a fine-grained personal access token.
